generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The prospective bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor at least one similar nature of Flameproof/ Electrical wiring works of value not less than Rs.17.96 lakhs from any Government/reputed organization in India in the last five years, i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26. In proof of this, the bidder shall upload work order along with corresponding work done certificate issued by competent authority. The value of the completed works shall be given in weightage of 10% per year to bring to the price level of current financial year.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order and Work done certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder in his name should have an average annual turnover of minimum Rs.35.92 lakhs during any two financial years in preceding five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. The agency shall upload Annual turnover certificate/statement duly signed by Chartered accountant for the two years. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring the current price level of current financial year).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Those bidders whose contracts have been terminated/fore-closed by KPCL or whose performance has not been satisfactory while executing the contract in last five years are not eligible to participate in the bid. The bidder shall furnish an undertaking in this regard. Bidders shall furnish declaration in this regard (as in Schedule-G).
